Design

Classes, abilities and skill-tree examples

Vanguard, Ranger, Arcanist and Warden: authored definitions on one compatible body.

On this page
Vanguard · Melee tankRanger · Bow/spear ranged skirmisherArcanist · Offensive magicWarden · Healing and support

Four common-body archetypes. Values below are initial authored examples, not tested balance or a complete level50 content library. Six ability and six talent-node examples per class define production patterns; expansion must preserve DAG/exclusivity/respec validation. Additional points may remain unspent until more content is authored.

Health +12, stamina +5, strength +2 per level; proposals Shield/mainhand or two-hand; armor stats do not imply layered armor art four-facing archive compatibility unverified; magical casts/heals need placeholders/new art
